summary: T-0633: recurrence of T-0371's identity-resolution bug in 9 route modules (agents-list.ts, llm-connections.ts, llm-config.ts, llm-connection-test.ts, spend.ts, grant-trail.ts, process-catalog.ts, app-secret.ts, pdp-explain.ts) plus one inline block (src/http/org.ts's GET /api/org handler). Each had a local, synchronous `extractActor(req): string` helper (or, in pdp-explain.ts, `extractCaller`; in org.ts, an inline block) that returned the RAW keycloak JWT `sub` in keycloak mode instead of resolving it to the real employee slug. Since employee.slug != KC sub for any seeded persona (including the genesis-owner), resolveActorTenant (keyed on employee.slug) could not find a matching row and threw HttpError(403, ACTOR_TENANT_UNRESOLVED) even for the legitimate tenant owner — hiding Agents, LLM connections, org structure, PDP-explain, spend, grant-trail, and the process catalog behind a false 403 for every keycloak-mode seeded persona. Fixed by mirroring the CANONICAL pattern already correct in src/http/agents.ts::extractActor (and org.ts's own /api/my-tenant + /api/me/nav-capabilities in the SAME file): each fixed extractActor/extractCaller/inline-block became async, took the route's pool, and called resolveActorSlugFromAuth(pool, ctx.sub, ctx.preferredUsername) (sub-first, preferred_username fallback, T-0371's canonical resolver, src/db/org.ts) — a null result now throws 401 UNAUTHENTICATED instead of silently falling through to an unresolvable UUID. dev mode (x-dev-user) is completely unchanged in every file. No authz predicate (canConfigureLlmConnection, loadAdminContext/holdsAgentMgmtUpdate, checkExplainAuthz) was touched — only the identity feeding into them was corrected, so a non-owner/no-grant caller still gets an honest 403 BY RIGHT (a specific authz code), never a free pass.
routes_fixed: POST /api/pdp/explain (src/http/pdp-explain.ts — narrower manifestation: tenantId is pinned to DEV_TENANT_ID regardless of actor per this route's Day-1 design, so the bug surfaced as a wrong `caller` value feeding the self-query check and loadAdminContext's actor key, not as ACTOR_TENANT_UNRESOLVED)
GET /api/org (src/http/org.ts — bug was inlined in the GET /api/org handler only; /api/my-tenant and /api/me/nav-capabilities in the same file were already correct)
resolver_used: resolveActorSlugFromAuth(pool, sub, preferredUsername) — src/db/org.ts:450-503, the canonical T-0371 resolver. Contract: (1) sub-first — if an employee with slug===sub (kind='human') exists, return sub (short-circuits for self-registered users, T-0342 invariant); (2) else if an employee with slug===preferredUsername (kind='human') exists and preferredUsername!==sub, return preferredUsername (the seeded-persona fallback); (3) else null (fail-closed — the caller must throw 401, never fall through to an unresolvable UUID). Not modified by this task — reused as-is in every fixed file, mirroring src/http/agents.ts's existing extractActor.
not_fixed_confirmed_correct: PUT /api/agents/:id/llm-connection (src/http/agents.ts) — named as a suspect in the original task brief; code-truth investigation (read the function line-by-line, then proved it with an HTTP-level regression test in ci/checks/db/actor-resolve-seeded-persona.db.test.ts's sibling routes) confirmed agents.ts::extractActor is ALREADY async and ALREADY calls resolveActorSlugFromAuth. Left byte-untouched; NOT counted among the 9 fixed routes.

friction_events: First live-DB test-file draft wired the 9 fixed routes against the choros_app (NOBYPASSRLS) pool (mirroring one existing test file's convention for two of the nine routes). resolveActorSlugFromAuth/resolveActorTenant are documented BYPASSRLS-only helpers (src/db/org.ts comments) with no tenant GUC set before their cross-tenant existence-check query — under NOBYPASSRLS (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on choros.employee, migration 016) they saw zero employee rows regardless of seed data, producing a false '401 no employee matches' across all 17 new assertions. Root-caused by checking docker-compose.yml (production DATABASE_URL resolves to choros_migrator, not choros_app) and the org.ts doc comments; fixed by wiring all 9 routes + org.ts against the migrator (BYPASSRLS) pool, matching production wiring exactly. Re-run confirmed 17/17 green.

pdp-explain.ts's identity bug does not manifest as ACTOR_TENANT_UNRESOLVED (its tenantId is hardcoded to DEV_TENANT_ID regardless of the actor, a pre-existing Day-1 single-tenant scoping choice unrelated to this task) — required tracing the actual failure mode (self-query check + loadAdminContext keyed on the wrong `caller`) rather than assuming a uniform symptom across all 9+1 routes, and a separate, narrower regression test in the existing stub-pool-based src/__tests__/pdp-explain.test.ts rather than the live-DB harness used for the other 8 routes + org.ts.
